title: Kissed Silky Mediterranean Apple Tagine
description: A jammy and silky Mediterranean dish featuring applesauce, with a nostalgic and smoky flavor, made with satvik-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other sweet varieties

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is softened and lightly caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped apples, honey, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the apples are tender.
Mash the apples with a fork or potato masher to create a silky texture.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
